mcp-server/config.example.yaml:
# DailyTickers MCP Server Configuration
# Copy to config.yaml and edit with your settings

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# DATA SOURCES
# ══════════════════════════════════════
sources:
  yahoo:
    enabled: true
    # No API key needed — uses public Yahoo Finance v8 API
    polling_interval: 15  # seconds for realtime quotes
    cache_ttl:
      quotes: 15          # seconds
      bars: 300           # 5 minutes
      financials: 86400   # 24 hours
      options: 600        # 10 minutes
      news: 300           # 5 minutes

  binance:
    enabled: true
    # No API key needed for public data
    websocket: true       # realtime via WebSocket
    symbols:              # crypto pairs to track
      - BTCUSDT
      - ETHUSDT
      - SOLUSDT
      - XRPUSDT
      - DOGEUSDT

  sec_edgar:
    enabled: true
    user_agent: "DailyTickers MCP contact@dailytickers.com"
    # SEC requires a User-Agent with contact info
    filing_types:         # filings to track
      - "10-K"
      - "10-Q"
      - "8-K"
      - "4"               # insider transactions
      - "13F-HR"          # institutional holdings

  webull:
    enabled: true
    # No API key needed — uses public Webull webapp API
    # Provides: market overview, rankings (8 period tabs), screener (9 filters),
    # full quotes (78 fields), capital flow, earnings/dividend/splits calendar,
    # social sentiment, charts (all intervals including crypto)
    cache_ttl:
      market: 120         # 2 minutes
      quotes: 30          # 30 seconds
      charts: 120         # 2 minutes
      screener: 120       # 2 minutes
      calendar: 300       # 5 minutes
      social: 300         # 5 minutes

  fred:
    enabled: false
    api_key: ""           # Get free key at https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html
    series:
      - VIXCLS            # VIX
      - DGS10             # 10-Year Treasury
      - CPIAUCSL          # CPI
      - UNRATE            # Unemployment
      - FEDFUNDS          # Fed Funds Rate

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# LOCAL LLM ORCHESTRATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════
# Auto-detects AI CLIs installed on your machine (claude, gemini).
# Enables cross-model collaboration: any MCP client can invoke other AIs.
# No configuration needed — detection is automatic at startup.
# Tools: local_llm_list, local_llm_invoke, local_llm_consensus
local_llm:
  enabled: true           # set to false to disable feature detection
  timeout: 180000         # default timeout for CLI invocations (ms)
  # Supported CLIs (auto-detected):
  #   claude  — Claude Code (claude -p). Code analysis, refactoring, MCP-aware.
  #   gemini  — Gemini CLI (gemini -p). Web-grounded search, fact-checking.

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# AI / LLM (for local analysis — built-in LLM for news sentiment, DD reports)
# ══════════════════════════════════════
llm:
  provider: "deepseek"    # deepseek (free), openai, anthropic, ollama
  deepseek:
    api_key: ""           # Get free key at https://platform.deepseek.com/
    model: "deepseek-chat"
    max_tokens: 4096
  openai:
    api_key: ""
    model: "gpt-4o-mini"
  anthropic:
    api_key: ""
    model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"
  ollama:
    url: "http://localhost:11434"
    model: "llama3.2"
  # Used for: news sentiment analysis, DD reports, alert enrichment, morning briefings

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# WATCHLIST & SCANNER
# ══════════════════════════════════════
watchlist:
  sync_url: "https://articles.dailytickers.com/mcp/watchlist.json"
  sync_interval: 3600     # seconds (1 hour)
  custom_tickers: []      # add your own tickers on top of scanner picks
  # custom_tickers: ["CRWD", "PANW", "SNOW"]

scanner:
  enabled: true
  universe: "sp500"       # sp500, russell2000, custom
  custom_universe: []     # tickers if universe=custom
  interval: 300           # seconds between scans (5 min)
  presets:
    momentum:
      enabled: true
      filters:
        rsi_min: 60
        rsi_max: 80
        rvol_min: 2.0
        above_50ma: true
        new_high_pct: 10   # within 10% of 52-week high
    breakout:
      enabled: true
      filters:
        consolidation_days: 20
        volume_contraction: true
        bollinger_squeeze: true
    mean_reversion:
      enabled: true
      filters:
        rsi_max: 30
        at_support: true
        insider_buying_90d: true

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# ALERTS & NOTIFICATIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════
alerts:
  enabled: true
  throttle: 60            # min seconds between alerts for same ticker
  channels:
    desktop:
      enabled: true
      types: ["entry", "stop", "tp", "news_critical", "regime_change"]

    slack:
      enabled: false
      webhook_url: ""     # https://hooks.slack.com/services/T.../B.../xxx
      types: ["entry", "stop", "tp", "news", "earnings", "regime_change"]

    discord:
      enabled: false
      webhook_url: ""     # https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc
      types: ["entry", "stop", "tp", "regime_change", "scanner"]

    telegram:
      enabled: false
      bot_token: ""       # from @BotFather
      chat_id: ""         # your chat ID
      types: ["all"]

  # Alert types:
  # entry        — price enters watchlist entry zone
  # stop         — price hits stop loss level
  # tp           — price hits take profit (TP1, TP2)
  # news         — significant news on watchlist ticker
  # news_critical — breaking news with high impact score
  # earnings     — earnings report within 24h for watchlist ticker
  # regime_change — market regime shifts (e.g. Risk-On → Risk-Off)
  # scanner      — new scanner pick detected
  # insider      — insider buying/selling on watchlist ticker
  # volume_spike — volume surge >3x average on watchlist ticker
  # sec_filing   — new SEC filing for watchlist ticker
  # vwap_reclaim — price reclaims VWAP with confirmation candle

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# TRADE JOURNAL
# ══════════════════════════════════════
journal:
  enabled: true
  db_path: "./data/journal.db"   # SQLite database
  auto_log: true                  # auto-log alert-triggered events
  screenshot: false               # requires puppeteer (heavy)

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# DASHBOARD
# ══════════════════════════════════════
dashboard:
  enabled: true
  port: 3847
  auto_open: true         # open browser on start

# ══════════════════════════════════════
# BROWSER EXTENSION
# ══════════════════════════════════════
extension:
  port: 3848              # WebSocket port for extension communication
  enabled: true
